summary: Dell Alienware 16x AC16251 (Core Ultra 9 275HX) - System State Baseline
intent: Analyze system issue with jitters/stutters during tab switching, Windows switching, and video playback.
detected_fault: Jitters/Stutters during Tab Switching, Windows Switching, and Video Playback
suggested_solution: Verify all NVIDIA drivers are up-to-date
Check for BIOS updates for the Core i9-9750H processor and apply if available
Disable PCI Express under Advanced Power Settings
